description: Dept. of Census and Statistics - The Colombo Consumers' Price Index for the month of March 2015 was 178.1
categorisation: This gazette notification announces the Colombo Consumers' Price Index computed by the Department of Census and Statistics. It does not involve government structural changes, personnel appointments, or detailed portfolio responsibilities (Types 1-3). It also doesn't fit any specialized categories (land, legal, commercial, elections, public service, or judicial matters). This is a statistical announcement about economic indicators, which falls under miscellaneous administrative matters not covered by other categories.
